critical.label: Apache
critical.description: Session Fixation in the login flow of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. The session identifier was not replaced when a user authenticated, so an attacker who could set a known session identifier in the browser of a victim could use the same identifier after the victim logged in. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 (3.x) or 2.12.6 (2.x), which fix this issue.
